title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana
shortDescription: Provides ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments directly to landholding farmer families.
fullDescription: Provides ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments directly to landholding farmer families.
benefits: ₹6,000 annual income support through DBT.
eligibility: Landholding farmer families as per government rules.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
shortDescription: Voluntary pension scheme for small and marginal farmers aged 18 to 40 years.
fullDescription: Voluntary pension scheme for small and marginal farmers aged 18 to 40 years.
benefits: ₹3,000 monthly pension after age 60.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers aged 18–40 years.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
shortDescription: Provides crop insurance against losses due to non-preventable natural risks.
fullDescription: Provides crop insurance against losses due to non-preventable natural risks.
benefits: Low farmer premium: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops
eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.

title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
shortDescription: Promotes micro-irrigation under Per Drop More Crop.
fullDescription: Promotes micro-irrigation under Per Drop More Crop.
benefits: Subsidy support for drip and sprinkler irrigation.
eligibility: Farmers adopting irrigation and water conservation methods.

title: Kisan Credit Card Scheme
shortDescription: Provides short-term crop credit and agriculture loans at subsidized interest rates.
fullDescription: Provides short-term crop credit and agriculture loans at subsidized interest rates.
benefits: Credit support for crop cultivation and allied activities. Interest may be around 4% on timely repayment.
eligibility: Farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, self-help groups.

title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
shortDescription: Financing facility for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
fullDescription: Financing facility for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
benefits: Credit support for warehouses, cold storage, processing units, and community assets.
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, cooperatives, agri entrepreneurs.

title: e-NAM National Agriculture Market
shortDescription: Digital platform connecting APMC mandis to create a unified national agriculture market.
fullDescription: Digital platform connecting APMC mandis to create a unified national agriculture market.
benefits: Better market access and transparent price discovery.
eligibility: Farmers registered with participating mandis.

title: Rythu Bandhu
shortDescription: Investment support to farmers for cultivation costs.
fullDescription: Investment support to farmers for cultivation costs.
benefits: Financial support per acre as per state rules.
eligibility: Farmers in Telangana.

title: Rythu Bima
shortDescription: Group life insurance scheme for farmers.
fullDescription: Group life insurance scheme for farmers.
benefits: ₹5 lakh coverage to family members in case of farmer death.
eligibility: Eligible farmers in Telangana.

title: KALIA Scheme
shortDescription: Financial assistance to small/marginal farmers and landless agricultural households.
fullDescription: Financial assistance to small/marginal farmers and landless agricultural households.
benefits: Support for cultivation and livelihood activities like goat rearing and fishery.
eligibility: Small farmers, marginal farmers, landless agricultural households.

title: YSR Rythu Bharosa
shortDescription: Annual crop investment support to farmers including tenant farmers.
fullDescription: Annual crop investment support to farmers including tenant farmers.
benefits: ₹13,500 annually in installments.
eligibility: Eligible farmers and tenant farmers in Andhra Pradesh.

title: Krishak Bandhu
shortDescription: Financial support and death benefit scheme for farmers.
fullDescription: Financial support and death benefit scheme for farmers.
benefits: ₹10,000 per year for farmers with 1 acre or more. Death benefit of ₹2 lakh.
eligibility: Farmers in West Bengal.

title: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana
shortDescription: Top-up financial support for PM-KISAN beneficiaries.
fullDescription: Top-up financial support for PM-KISAN beneficiaries.
benefits: Additional ₹6,000 paid in installments.
eligibility: PM-KISAN beneficiaries in Madhya Pradesh.

title: Rajiv Gandhi Kisan Nyay Yojana
shortDescription: Input subsidy and financial assistance to encourage crop production.
fullDescription: Input subsidy and financial assistance to encourage crop production.
benefits: Approximate input subsidy per acre as per state rules.
eligibility: Eligible farmers in Chhattisgarh.

title: Godhan Nyay Yojana
shortDescription: State procurement of cow dung from farmers and cattle rearers.
fullDescription: State procurement of cow dung from farmers and cattle rearers.
benefits: Additional income and vermicompost production.
eligibility: Farmers and cattle rearers in Chhattisgarh.

title: Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
shortDescription: Crop relief scheme providing compensation for crop damage due to natural calamities.
fullDescription: Crop relief scheme providing compensation for crop damage due to natural calamities.
benefits: ₹3,000–₹4,000 per acre compensation depending on damage.
eligibility: Farmers in Jharkhand affected by crop loss.

title: Raitha Vidya Nidhi
shortDescription: Scholarship scheme for children of farmers.
fullDescription: Scholarship scheme for children of farmers.
benefits: Scholarship support ranging from ₹2,500 to ₹11,000.
eligibility: Children of farmers in Karnataka.

title: National Food Security Mission
shortDescription: Supports increased production of rice, wheat, pulses, and coarse cereals.
fullDescription: Supports increased production of rice, wheat, pulses, and coarse cereals.
benefits: Support for seeds, demonstrations, productivity enhancement, and area expansion.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating notified food grain crops.

title: NFSM Commercial Crops
shortDescription: Supports productivity improvement for cotton, jute, and sugarcane.
fullDescription: Supports productivity improvement for cotton, jute, and sugarcane.
benefits: Technology transfer, input support, and productivity improvement.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating commercial crops.

title: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture
shortDescription: Supports horticulture development, nurseries, planting material, and post-harvest management.
fullDescription: Supports horticulture development, nurseries, planting material, and post-harvest management.
benefits: Support for horticulture infrastructure, planting material, and post-harvest facilities.
eligibility: Farmers involved in horticulture crops.

title: National Mission on Edible Oils - Oil Palm
shortDescription: Promotes oil palm cultivation to reduce import dependence.
fullDescription: Promotes oil palm cultivation to reduce import dependence.
benefits: Support for planting material, cultivation, and expansion.
eligibility: Farmers suitable for oil palm cultivation.

title: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
shortDescription: Promotes organic farming through cluster-based approach.
fullDescription: Promotes organic farming through cluster-based approach.
benefits: Support for organic inputs, certification, and cluster development.
eligibility: Farmers willing to adopt organic farming.

title: National Mission on Natural Farming
shortDescription: Promotes chemical-free natural farming.
fullDescription: Promotes chemical-free natural farming.
benefits: Training, support, and promotion of natural farming practices.
eligibility: Farmers adopting natural farming.

title: Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure
shortDescription: Supports creation of storage and warehouse infrastructure.
fullDescription: Supports creation of storage and warehouse infrastructure.
benefits: Higher subsidy for women farmers and SC/ST farmers.
eligibility: Farmers, farmer groups, entrepreneurs creating storage infrastructure.

title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization
shortDescription: Provides subsidy support for purchasing agricultural machinery.
fullDescription: Provides subsidy support for purchasing agricultural machinery.
benefits: Women and SC/ST farmers may receive higher subsidy, often up to 50%.
eligibility: Farmers purchasing eligible agricultural machinery.

title: Stand-Up India
shortDescription: Provides bank loans for SC/ST and women borrowers for greenfield enterprises.
fullDescription: Provides bank loans for SC/ST and women borrowers for greenfield enterprises.
benefits: Loan support for agriculture and allied business enterprises.
eligibility: SC/ST or women entrepreneurs setting up new enterprises.
